title: Learning Stabilizing Latent Feedback Controllers via Multi-Step Backward Losses
abstract: arXiv:2610.40931v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can learned latent dynamics models support the design of feedback controllers that provably stabilize the original system? For linear time-invariant systems, we show that learning linear autoencoders and latent dynamics with multi-step prediction-reconstruction losses $\unicode{x2014}$ which we term "backward losses" as they encourage latent trajectories to reconstruct full state trajectories $\unicode{x2014}$ provably recovers the structure needed for stabilization. Specifically, a sufficiently long reconstruction horizon ensures that a minimum ${H}_\infty$-norm controller designed using the learned latent model stabilizes the original system through output-feedback via the corresponding encoder, provided the latent dimension is large enough to capture all non-stable modes of the underlying system. We also show why both reconstruction and a multi-step horizon are essential: forward prediction losses that require only low prediction er

translated_title: 基于多步反向损失学习可稳定系统的潜在反馈控制器
translated_abstract: 学习到的潜在动力学模型能否支持设计可证明能稳定原始系统的反馈控制器？对于线性时不变系统，我们证明：使用多步预测-重构损失来学习线性自编码器与潜在动力学——我们将其称为“反向损失”，因为它鼓励潜在轨迹重构完整的状态轨迹——可以可证明地恢复稳定化所需的结构。具体而言，只要潜在维度足够大以捕捉底层系统的所有非稳定模态，足够长的重构视野即可保证：使用学习到的潜在模型设计的最小 $H_\infty$ 范数控制器，能够通过相应编码器实现输出反馈，从而稳定原始系统。我们还阐明了为什么重构与多步视野二者都不可或缺：仅要求低预测误差的前向预测损失……
tldr: 该论文证明，对于线性时不变系统，以多步“反向”预测-重构损失学习线性自编码器与潜在动力学，只要潜在维度足够大且重构视野足够长，基于学习到的潜在模型设计的最小 $H_\infty$ 范数控制器即可通过编码器输出反馈可证明地稳定原始系统。
en_tdlr: For linear time-invariant systems, learning linear autoencoders and latent dynamics with multi-step "backward" prediction-reconstruction losses provably recovers the structure needed for stabilization, so that a minimum $H_\infty$-norm controller designed from the learned latent model stabilizes the original system via encoder-based output feedback, provided the latent dimension and reconstruction horizon are sufficiently large.
